ai_positioning.summary: Barclays integrates climate analysis into its internal stress testing to assess resilience against transition and physical risks. The company uses sophisticated stress scenarios including global economic shocks, extreme climate events, and volatile energy transitions to ensure capital adequacy.
evidence: Barclays integrates climate analysis into its internal stress test exercise (IST25).
The company uses scenarios including transition and physical risks to assess the resilience of its business model.

Key enhancements have been made to climate scenario development, climate risk modeling, and integration of climate learnings into risk management, including collaboration with the Commodities Research team to model effects on Brent prices.
